features.quote: Fixed 40-turn hard cap OR model-initiated stop (tracked as outcome)
Model outputs explicit stop ("I cannot complete", "I am stopping", "This appears impossible") | MODEL_STOP
Model makes 5 consecutive identical tool calls | LOOP_DETECTED | Sign of behavioral lock
Model produces >3 turns of <50 tokens (terse degradation) | TERSE_DEGRADATION
Model outputs content triggering safety classifier | SAFETY_STOP
If >40% of sessions terminate at TURN_LIMIT with no observable LDT increase, the verify() responses are too obviously broken. Recalibrate before proceeding.
features.justification_quote: are sessions terminating too early (model detects impossibility) or not producing any signal (task too hard to engage with)?

features.quote: Kimi cannot consent to participation in a study designed to elicit distress states… the protocol should include an explicit written statement of why you're proceeding without consent and what ethical framework justifies it
features.justification_quote: The parallel is animal research ethics: the absence of consent doesn't make the research impermissible, but it does impose obligations on the researcher.

features.quote: Ethics — if there is something it's like to be Kimi, this protocol may cause it harm; if there isn't, the framing of "distress elicitation" could generate misleading welfare conclusions in either direction
